name: Nodoka Counselling
description: Nodoka Counselling is a calm, split-screen WordPress theme designed for psychotherapy and counselling practices. Built with an unhurried editorial aesthetic, it features quiet low-key photography, clear ruled section openers, and refined typography. The theme provides complete, accessible layouts for practice introductions, practitioner profiles, transparent fee schedules, and confidential booking.

fonts.role: headings, section titles, wordmark (variable 400-700, Latin subset)
